decisions.reason: Q3 was built and barely reached, and the engine's reach figures confirm it. The brief's rule that every named thing deserves a description, and round 5's precedent of giving a chain a voice, both point the same way. The gates now speak: the cracked rock beside the Great Door before the quake, 776's stone door saying it opens only from inside the Jewel Room, the present's machine saying it moves, and the puzzle hole saying the dark below goes on and was built to be got out of.

Accepted as the synthesis frames it: no change to any odds. The blockers it names are answered under P1, P3, P4, P6, P7, P8 and P9; the figure's, grues', roc's, fish's and man's chances are the original's and stay.

The shore's warning read as a list of two, and two opus runs lost the staff, the vial and the waybread to it. The shore and the lake examined now say everything in the hands goes to the bottom, not the light and the sword only; the 'What you wear, it leaves you' clause is kept; the dive's plunge names the waybread as the walk-in's does.

'A lit thing goes under here' taught the wrong rule and a visitor lost the lamp by acting on it. The told line now says a lamp goes under lit or dark and comes up dead, and keeps the 'shore is where it should be left' clause.

A fixed line read for a lamp whose state it did not read. The plunge now has three cases, as recommended: lit (the hiss and the glow), dark but whole (a hiss, no glow, and it will not light again), already ruined (it goes under and the lake does nothing further to it).

Round 5's sequence keyed beats to ranges of the timer, so the first beat said itself three times. Each of the nine waits now has its own beat (lock, lid, whistle, coins, recount, gathering up, pacing, brink, rope shifting); the man's ten moves are the original's and untouched.

Three sonnet visitors left the ledge in two to five moves, each trying to call up in words the world did not read. 'call up', 'call up to the man', 'shout up to the person above', 'talk to man', 'hail man' and 'hello' now reach the shout, answered by stage, and the stage-one chuckle carries the remark the recommendation asked for: a heavy-looking chest, and a pity there is no way of sending it up. His five-move timing is left alone. A relative clause ('whoever is there') and a sentence after a comma are still the parser's; logged under friction 38.

Neither opus run knew the can held one dose, and both learned it by dying. 'examine can' and 'read can' now carry the small print (one application, a few minutes, do not stop to admire the scenery); the five moves are exactly as they were, and the intent's secret about a look on the way stands.

The trap is the hint book's and stays; the recommendation asked only that it be told at the brink. After the quake the Key Room, the cover examined, looked in and under, and the hole all say plainly that the channel below goes nowhere now and the drop is not one that is climbed back.

The brief's own rule: a verb is offered only where something it applies to is in range. The sitting verb's role is now typed by a Seatable kind only the gold machine and its seat compose, so 'sit in machine' has one machine to mean. Bare 'examine machine' is still friction 49's draw, as the point asked.

Each is a named thing without an answer, or a throw that silently dropped the thing at the visitor's feet. 'gap', 'break' and 'breach' are the arch's words in every aqueduct room and the Aqueduct has the arch; throws at the far balcony and the chasm are refused in round 5's voice with the thing kept; 'vegetation' and 'plants' are the trees' words at the Cliff; 'put torch back on wall' sets the torch in its bracket. Fixing the Vista's wall also uncovered that it read the Engravings Room's carved-wall text; it has its own now.

Two lines in one strike contradicted each other. The feint's 'You are hurt very badly' is now said only when the state line agrees (two points or fewer left); at three the stroke slips the sword in and out instead.

The image and the indicator disagreed in one turn and a visitor died of trusting the image. The exact recommendation (flicker first, then the new image) needed a per-visitor hush of the end-of-turn line, which a describe cannot set (friction 54); instead, on the move the indicator is about to change, the table shows no image and says the indicator is flickering, so the two are never read disagreeing. One move's image is the price.
No change, as the point asks: four duels fought to the last point, two took the hood, two struck and regretted it afterwards. The trap is working as designed, and as round 5 held.

Optional and in character, and it costs nothing faithful: on the third visit the old man says three times now he has sent the visitor back, that the power is not in endless store, and that he does not think there is a fourth in him. The lamp stays at the visitor's feet, as the original leaves it.

Low priority and the original's opening, but the hook is cheap: while the man is unmet, the Cliff's rope line now ends with something among the trees that is not a tree, keeping very still. Nothing else about the opening changes.

changes.what: Q3's gates given a voice: before the quake the Great Door's description and the iron door examined name the cracked, strained rock beside the door, and a cracked_rock scenery object answers examine, look in, listen and push and goes unseen at the quake; the Great Door's debris is its own thing (no 'rock' noun) so the word is the cracked rock's; in 776 the stone door tried from the entrance says it has no keyhole or handle on that side and opens only from inside the Jewel Room, and the entrance's way east says the same; the present's gold machine examined or touched says it stands on the floor, the floor is scuffed in arcs toward the door, and it rocks under a hand; the puzzle hole examined and looked into says the dark below goes on square-cut into more rooms and was built to be got out of by another way.

The Lake Shore's description and the lake examined say everything in the hands goes to the bottom, not the light and the sword only; the returning-light line says a lamp goes under lit or dark and comes up dead; the bare dive's plunge names the waybread as the walk-in's does.

The lamp's plunge line reads the lamp's state in all four plunge paths: lit (hiss and glow), dark but whole (hiss, no glow, will not light again), already fried or broken (it goes under and the lake does nothing further to it).

The ledge's wait while the man is away is nine beats keyed to single timer values (lock, lid, whistle, coins, recount, gathering up, pacing, brink, rope shifting), none repeated; the man's timing is unchanged.

Calling up to the man: a call_up intent ('call up', 'yell up', 'call up the cliff' and kin) over the bare shout, a call_up_to intent ('call up to [x]', 'shout up to [x]' and kin) over hail; the man as the ledge hears him gains 'person', 'somebody', 'someone' and the adjectives 'above', 'up', 'top', answers greet, hail and talk in every stage (exempted from his absent permit), and the stage-one chuckle in shout, hello, who-is-there and the man's own answers carries the remark about the heavy chest and no way of sending it up.
The repellent's examine and label carry the small print: one application, a few minutes' effect, do not stop to admire the scenery; the five moves are untouched.

After the quake the Key Room's description, the cover examined, looked in and looked under, and the hole examined all say plainly that the channel below goes nowhere now and the drop is not one that is climbed back; the trap itself is unchanged.

A Seatable marker kind, composed by the gold machine and its seat only; the sit_in intent over 'through' replaced by a board verb whose target is Seatable ('sit in', 'sit on', 'climb into', 'get on', 'take a seat in' and kin), with the adventurer's actor part doing the climb-in, so a bare 'machine' resolves to the gold one.

Named-scenery and throw gaps: the arch gains 'gap', 'break', 'breach' and a per-room description, and the Aqueduct gets an arch object; the High Arch's balcony is a FarBalcony kind and throws at it or at the chasm are refused in round 5's voice with the thing kept; the Cliff's trees answer 'vegetation' and 'plants'; put_on gains 'put [item] back on', 'hang', 'mount', 'replace'; the room's Wall kind gets a Vista text (the Vista's :walls moved from the Engravings Room's 15 to a new 25) and a put_on surface part, a TorchBracket kind in the Vista takes the torch too, and the adventurer's put_on part moves the torch for either (a wall cannot move what it does not hold, friction 53).

The feint's 'You are hurt very badly' is said only when the resulting state is two points or fewer; at three the stroke slips the sword between the ribs and out again, so the strike and the state line agree.

On the move the indicator is about to change (view_tick 3), the viewing table's examine, look in and search show no image and say the indicator is flickering and the table will show nothing until it settles; the end-of-turn flicker line and the next look's image then agree.
The old man's third visit has its own line: three times sent back, the power not in endless store, no fourth in him; chosen by the visitor's death count in his send_back part.
While the man is unmet, the Cliff's rope line at the top ends with something among the trees that is not a tree, keeping very still.

Eleven tests re-recorded with sprout play --write for the changed prose (the shore's lines, the nine wait beats, the cliff-top hint, the machine's description, the flicker, the old man's third line), their typed lines and seeds unchanged; the walkthrough still plays to 7 of 7 in 208 moves. check and test pass.

intent.md gains the 'Round 7 (the revision after round 6)' section covering every accepted point and four new secrets; friction.md gains entries 53 (a thing cannot move what it does not hold), 54 (a describe cannot send, so the flicker could not be hushed), 55 (the caps of eight phrases and eight nouns), and status notes on 38 and 49.
